title: ServiceNow HAM Business Analyst
description:
We are looking for an experienced
 **ServiceNow HAM Business Analyst** 
 with strong expertise in
 **Hardware Asset Management (HAM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), and ServiceNow** 
 . The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, Asset Management, Procurement, Finance, IT Operations, ServiceNow Architects, Developers, and Project Managers to gather requirements, define HAM processes, create user stories, coordinate UAT, and support successful implementation and enhancement initiatives.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Conduct requirement\-gathering workshops and stakeholder discussions for ServiceNow HAM/ITAM initiatives.
* Analyze current\-state and future\-state hardware asset lifecycle processes and identify process improvements.
* Prepare BRDs, FRDs, process flows, user stories, business rules, acceptance criteria, and requirement traceability.
* Define requirements covering asset procurement, receiving, stockroom management, allocation, transfer, warranty, refresh, retirement, disposal, audit, and compliance.
* Work with Procurement, Finance, IT Operations, and ITAM teams to align asset processes with business and governance requirements.
* Support asset data migration, normalization, reconciliation, validation, and CMDB alignment.
* Define functional requirements for HAM dashboards, reports, KPIs, compliance and asset governance.
* Collaborate with ServiceNow Architects and Developers to translate business requirements into functional solutions.
* Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, sprint reviews, demos, and requirement walkthroughs.
* Create UAT scenarios and coordinate UAT execution, defect triage, business validation, and sign\-off.
* Support release readiness, deployment activities, post\-go\-live support, and enhancement initiatives.
* Track risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and change requests throughout the project lifecycle.
* Ensure requirements and deliverables are properly documented and traceable.


 Mandatory Skills
   

  

* Strong experience in ServiceNow HAM / ITAM.
* Strong understanding of Hardware Asset Management and asset lifecycle processes.
* Experience with asset procurement, receiving, stockrooms, allocation, transfers, warranty, refresh, retirement, disposal, and audits.
* Strong Business Analysis experience including requirement gathering, BRD/FRD, process mapping, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Good understanding of ServiceNow platform capabilities, including forms, lists, flows, reports, dashboards, roles/groups and basic ACL concepts.
* Experience with asset data migration, reconciliation, normalization, and CMDB alignment.
* Experience in UAT coordination, defect management, Agile/Scrum delivery, and stakeholder management.
* Excellent communication and client\-facing skills.


 Good to Have
   

  

* ServiceNow CSA Certification.
* ServiceNow CIS – IT Asset Management (CIS\-ITAM) certification.
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* CBAP, CCBA, or equivalent Business Analysis certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow HAM implementation, enhancement, AMS, or post\-go\-live support.
* Knowledge of integrations between ServiceNow HAM, CMDB, Procurement, Finance, and other enterprise systems.


 Education
   

  

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related discipline. MBA or Business Analysis certification is an added advantage.
   

  

 Key Competencies
   

  

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent stakeholder and workshop management.
* Strong documentation and presentation skills.
* Ability to work with global and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of ITAM governance and asset lifecycle management.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, dependencies, and changing requirements.

title: Research Analyst - Market & Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement
description:
**Description and Requirements**
**"At BMC trust is not just a word \- it's a way of life!"** 
**Hybrid**
 Description and Requirements
   

  

 BMC empowers nearly 80% of the Forbes Global 100 to accelerate business value, faster than humanly possible. Our industry\-leading portfolio unlocks human and machine potential to drive business growth, innovation, and sustainable success. BMC does this in a simple and optimized way by connecting people, systems, and data that power the world’s largest organizations so they can seize a competitive advantage.
   

  

 Business Unit
   

  

 The Sales Innovation, Growth and Market Acceleration (SIGMA) group partners with the Sales organization to improve seller productivity, strengthen customer engagement, and accelerate growth. This role supports two complementary priorities within SIGMA: AI\-enabled Market \& Competitive Intelligence and the operational execution of Digital Sales programs.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a strategic and execution\-oriented professional for a dual\-role position supporting Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%) and Digital Sales PMO and Administration (50%).
   

  

 The successful candidate will help transform traditional market and competitive intelligence into an AI\-enabled function through Generative AI, Agentic AI, automation, intelligent research workflows, and Copilot\-based solutions. In parallel, the individual will provide PMO and operational support for Digital Sales programs, ensuring effective governance, coordination, reporting, process administration, and execution management.
   

  

 The ideal candidate combines hands\-on AI implementation experience with strong program management, stakeholder coordination, business operations, and administrative capabilities. The individual must be comfortable building and scaling AI capabilities while delivering disciplined operational execution across the two workstreams.
   

  

 Indicative role allocation: 50% MCI AI Enablement \| 50% Digital Sales PMO and Administration
   

  

**Primary Roles And Responsibilities**
 Market \& Competitive Intelligence AI Enablement (50%)
   

  

* Lead the adoption and operationalization of Generative AI, Agentic AI, and intelligent automation solutions across the Market \& Competitive Intelligence function.
* Design, build, deploy, administer, and continuously improve AI\-powered intelligence agents that support competitive intelligence, customer intelligence, market research, executive briefings, and knowledge discovery.
* Develop and manage AI\-enabled research workflows that integrate approved internal repositories, external data sources, analyst content, and enterprise knowledge assets.
* Create and optimize prompts, agent instructions, orchestration workflows, grounding strategies, and retrieval approaches to improve the quality, consistency, traceability, and reliability of AI\-generated outputs.
* Establish and apply AI governance, evaluation, risk\-management, responsible\-AI, and quality\-assurance processes to ensure trusted, compliant, source\-backed, and business\-ready intelligence deliverables.
* Partner with MCI and business stakeholders to identify, prioritize, prototype, and implement AI use cases that improve research productivity, insight generation, knowledge access, and decision support.
* Build and maintain AI knowledge repositories, prompt libraries, reusable agent components, templates, documentation, and best practices that enable scalable intelligence operations.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, models, and industry developments to identify opportunities or innovation and continuous improvement within the intelligence function.
* Define, measure, and report AI adoption, usage, output quality, productivity improvements, business outcomes, and operational effectiveness across supported initiatives.
* Develop AI\-driven reporting, automated intelligence updates, executive insight experiences, and self\-service knowledge\-delivery capabilities, while acting as a subject matter expert for Copilot, Copilot Studio, AI agents, prompt engineering, research automation, and intelligent workflow design.


 Digital Sales PMO and Administrative Support (50%)
   

  

* Provide PMO support for Digital Sales initiatives, including planning, scheduling, action tracking, dependency management, governance, and delivery coordination.
* Maintain project plans, roadmaps, milestone trackers, RACI matrices, risk and issue logs, decision records, and success metrics for assigned programs.
* Coordinate meetings and operating cadences, prepare agendas and pre\-reads, document decisions and actions, and follow up with owners to support timely closure.
* Coordinate global Digital Sales stakeholders and cross\-functional teams to maintain alignment, visibility, and execution against agreed priorities.
* Prepare and maintain dashboards, status reports, leadership updates, and other operational communications using accurate and current program data.
* Support process administration, documentation, knowledge repositories, intake and prioritization workflows, access requests, and other recurring operational activities.
* Track program risks, issues, dependencies, and change\-management or adoption activities, escalating items that require leadership attention.
* Support the administration and operational governance of Digital Sales tools and platforms, including user access, vendor coordination, license or usage tracking, adoption reporting, and issue follow\-through.


**Required Experience**
* 5\-8\+ years of relevant experience across AI enablement, business operations, market or competitive intelligence, research, consulting, PMO, program management, or related business functions.
* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with Generative AI platforms, AI agents, Copilot technologies, prompt engineering, retrieval and grounding approaches, research automation, or intelligent workflow solutions.
* Experience designing, implementing, administering, or supporting AI\-enabled business processes, agents, knowledge repositories, or research solutions.
* Experience establishing or applying AI governance, evaluation, responsible\-AI, quality\-assurance, and adoption practices in a business environment.
* At least 3 years of experience supporting enterprise programs, PMO activities, strategic initiatives, cross\-functional operations, or Digital Sales programs.
* Strong organizational and program\-coordination skills, including experience managing plans, schedules, actions, risks, dependencies, documentation, and recurring governance cadences.
* Experience creating executive reports, dashboards, presentations, operational metrics, and concise business communications.
* Experience coordinating senior stakeholders and global, cross\-functional teams across Sales, Digital Sales, Product Management, Pre\-Sales, Marketing, Strategy, or Technology functions.
* Ability to balance AI initiatives and operational workstreams, work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver consistently in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 productivity and collaboration tools, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Teams, and SharePoint.
* Strong attention to detail, data accuracy, confidentiality, and follow\-through.

 **Customer Success Data Analyst** 
 to join the global Customer Success organization in India. This mid\-senior individual contributor role will support the Reuters Connect and Reuters News Agency portfolio, helping customers realize measurable value from Reuters editorial content, data feeds, and media services.
   

  

 The Customer Success Data Analyst will transform customer usage data, engagement signals, commercial information, and product health metrics into clear and actionable insights. This role goes beyond producing reports: it is responsible for identifying the story behind the data, diagnosing adoption and engagement challenges, surfacing commercial risks and opportunities, and enabling Customer Success and Sales teams to make informed retention and growth decisions.
   

  

 Reporting to the Director of Customer \& Sales Enablement, the successful candidate will partner closely with Customer Success Managers, Sales, Editorial, Product, Data, Sales Enablement, and Commercial Policy \& Operations teams.  Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own and enhance customer health scoring methodologies across the Reuters portfolio, including defining metrics, developing models, and identifying early churn\-risk indicators.
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of individual accounts and customer segments to diagnose declining engagement, adoption gaps, underutilization, and commercial risk.
* Segment customers based on health, usage trends, engagement trajectory, commercial value, and expansion potential to support Customer Success and Sales prioritization.
* Analyze customer usage, product adoption, engagement, and commercial data to identify retention and growth opportunities.
* Develop and deliver reports, dashboards, scorecards, and insight\-led narratives for Customer Success Managers, Sales teams, senior stakeholders, and clients.
* Translate customer data into clear and actionable recommendations that support renewals, retention, adoption, expansion, and customer value realization.
* Support Quarterly Business Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, renewal discussions, and customer meetings with tailored data\-driven insights.
* Help customers understand their content consumption and product\-usage patterns and demonstrate the business value of Reuters products and services.
* Identify trends, anomalies, data patterns, and commercial signals while applying critical thinking to validate findings before presenting conclusions.
* Support customer feedback, Voice of Customer, and customer\-sentiment analysis initiatives.
* Partner with the Data team to build, improve, and maintain scalable reporting and analytics infrastructure.
* Use Salesforce and related tools for reporting, dashboard development, data management, customer activity tracking, and commercial analysis.
* Ensure data quality across Customer Success reporting by identifying, investigating, and resolving inconsistencies in CRM, usage, engagement, and customer\-record data.
* Collaborate with internal data teams, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure reporting data is accurate, complete, and reliable.
* Incorporate AI\-enabled tools and automation into reporting and analysis workflows to improve efficiency, consistency, and analytical depth.
* Work independently in a global, matrixed environment while managing multiple priorities, stakeholder requests, and reporting deadlines.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Four to six years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, commercial analytics, customer success analytics, sales operations, or a related field.
* Experience working in a SaaS, B2B, technology, media, data services, subscription, or customer\-focused commercial environment.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, including complex reporting, analysis, modeling, and presentation of findings.
* Strong hands\-on experience using Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence and data\-visualization platforms.
* Hands\-on Salesforce experience, including report creation, dashboard development, data management, activity tracking, and CRM data analysis.
* Demonstrated experience developing reports, dashboards, customer scorecards, analytical models, and recurring performance reporting.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking ability, including the ability to interrogate assumptions, validate data, and identify actionable findings.
* Experience analyzing customer engagement, product usage, customer adoption, retention, and commercial performance data.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to data accuracy, consistency, completeness, and quality.
* Ability to identify data issues, investigate root causes, and work with relevant stakeholders to resolve them.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Proven ability to present complex data findings clearly and confidently to non\-technical audiences, including external clients.
* Strong collaboration, stakeholder\-management, planning, prioritization, organization, and time\-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively and independently in a globally distributed and matrixed organization.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience developing or improving customer health\-scoring frameworks, engagement models, churn\-risk models, or customer segmentation methodologies.
* Experience with Net Promoter Score, Voice of Customer, customer\-feedback programs, or customer\-sentiment analysis.
* Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python for data extraction, transformation, data cleansing, analysis, and reporting automation.
* Familiarity with Customer Success platforms such as Gainsight, Totango, or similar customer\-health and engagement tools.
* Experience supporting Quarterly Business Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, client renewals, account planning, or commercial growth discussions.

* Experience analyzing how customers consume editorial content, data feeds, media products, or subscription\-based services.
* Experience using AI\-enabled tools for analytics, reporting automation, data analysis, or workflow improvement.
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and the ability to develop executive\-ready and client\-facing presentations.
* Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Editorial, Data, and Commercial Operations teams.


**What’s in it For You?**
* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.

This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.

* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.

title: Senior SME Consolidation
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Summary**
  

 NIQ is seeking a Senior SME – Consolidations to partner with the Global Process Owner (GPO) in managing and continuously improving the global consolidation and close process.
   

  

 This role is instrumental in ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and integrity of NIQ’s consolidated financial results, embedding robust governance, automation, and process standardisation across regions.
   

  

 The Senior SME acts as the technical deputy to the GPO, providing operational oversight, subject\-matter guidance, and analytical insights across the consolidation lifecycle. The role will also contribute to NIQ’s broader R2R transformation agenda, supporting initiatives under Project Compass and RTR Quality Board.
   

  

  

  





**Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Consolidation and Reporting**
  

 • Lead execution of monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidations for NIQ entities in OneStream, ensuring accuracy and adherence to close timelines.
   

  

 • Validate consolidation entries, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation adjustments to ensure first\-time\-right financial results.
   

  

 • Partner with Corporate Accounting and Controllership to finalise management and statutory consolidation packs and ensure alignment of group reporting.
   

  

 • Support the GPO in monitoring Close Cockpit milestones and escalation management during close cycles.
   

  





**Governance and Standardisation**
  

 • Maintain and update process documentation, SOPs, and L4 process maps for the consolidation process.
   

  

 • Ensure consistency in consolidation methodologies, data mapping, and chart\-of\-accounts alignment across legal entities.
   

  

 • Support GPO in embedding internal controls (SOX) and ensuring full audit readiness across regions.
   

  

 • Perform process quality reviews and recommend corrective actions for control and reconciliation gaps.
   

  





**Technology and Automation**
  

 • Act as OneStream system SME, supporting configuration changes, system testing, and enhancement requests.
   

  

 • Partner with Enablement and IT to deliver automation and analytics initiatives (RPA, Power BI dashboards, consolidation exception reporting).
   

  

 • Develop and maintain standardised consolidation templates, mapping tables, and validation scripts.
   

  





**Business Partnering and Stakeholder Engagement**
  

 • Liaise with regional controllers, service delivery leads, and corporate accounting teams to ensure smooth consolidation execution and issue resolution.
   

  

 • Provide technical accounting and system support for mergers, acquisitions, and entity restructures.
   

  

 • Collaborate with FP\&A and Corporate Reporting teams to provide insights into consolidated P\&L, balance sheet, and cash flow results.
   

  





**Continuous Improvement and Capability Building**
  

 • Drive root\-cause analysis of consolidation issues and lead remediation actions.
   

  

 • Support GPO in developing and delivering training modules for RTR teams on consolidation best practices.
   

  

 • Contribute to process transformation projects aimed at shortening the close cycle and improving data accuracy.
   

  





**Required Skills and Attributes
   

  

 Core Skills**
  

 • Deep technical expertise in global consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and foreign currency translation.
   

  

 • Strong understanding of end\-to\-end RTR processes, including their interlinkages with FP\&A, Tax, and Controllership.
   

  

 • Hands\-on proficiency in OneStream, Hyperion, or equivalent EPM systems; good knowledge of SAP data structures and ledger logic (0L/1L).
   

  

 • In\-depth knowledge of US GAAP and IFRS, particularly consolidation accounting, equity method, and non\-controlling interests.
   

  

 • Proven experience in managing financial close governance, reconciliation frameworks, and control compliance.
   

  

 • Ability to interpret and communicate complex accounting and system issues clearly to non\-technical stakeholders.
   

  

  

  





**Behavioural \& Leadership Skills (Modelled on GPO Capabilities)**
  

 • Process Excellence Mindset: Passion for continuous improvement, simplification, and first\-time\-right delivery.
   

  

 • Analytical Rigor: Ability to deep\-dive into data, identify anomalies, and provide actionable insights.
   

  

 • Influence Without Authority: Collaborates effectively across time zones, driving alignment without direct hierarchy.
   

  

 • Execution Discipline: Strong planning, prioritisation, and follow\-through to meet global close deadlines.
   

  

 • Change Agility: Comfortable working in a transformation environment with evolving systems and structures.
   

  

 • Stakeholder Stewardship: Builds trust with Controllers, SDLs, and Corporate Accounting through reliability and responsiveness.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related discipline.
   

  

 • Professional qualification (CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent) preferred.
   

  

 • 10–15 years of experience in Finance Operations, with at least 5 years in consolidation or group reporting.
   

  

 • Prior experience in global consolidation and reporting for multinational organisations is essential.
   

  

 • Exposure to OneStream or Hyperion implementations, process transformation, and automation initiatives desirable.
   

  





**Success Profile**
  

 • Operates as the technical backbone of NIQ’s global consolidation process.
   

  

 • Acts as the operational deputy to the GPO, ensuring process execution excellence and data integrity.
   

  

 • Demonstrates strong technical, analytical, and leadership maturity, preparing for future progression to process\-ownership roles.
   

  

 • Delivers accuracy, control, and speed — the three cornerstones of NIQ’s consolidation success.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**



* Flexible working environment
* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning
* Employee\-Assistance\-Program (EAP)

 NIQ is the world’s leading consumer intelligence company, delivering the most complete understanding of consumer buying behavior and revealing new pathways to growth. title: Sr Associate Support Engineer (AI/ML & Platform Operations)
description:

 We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.
   

  

**About The Team**
 At Workday, we bring technical rigor, customer empathy, and a spirit of fun to enterprise software. Our support team underpins operational excellence across Workday's digital experience, AI/ML platform, and Agent Factory initiative. Workday’s Agent Factory is our internal engine that builds, trains, and deploys autonomous AI agents to execute complex HR and Finance workflows, including expense processing, hiring, and workforce scheduling. We partner with core engineering to eliminate bottlenecks, maintain high platform availability, and ensure system reliability for our global customer base.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are seeking a customer\-focused Support Engineer to drive incident resolution, root\-cause analysis (RCA), and performance optimisation across Workday’s enterprise platform and autonomous AI agent workflows. In this high\-visibility role, you will analyze system metrics, debug cloud\-hosted ML service pipelines, inspect LLM orchestration layers, and manage critical customer escalations within strict SLAs. You will also partner directly with engineering and data science teams through feature iteration and optimisation. A key part of this role involves hands\-on AI evaluation: analysing LLM outputs, reviewing conversation logs, and digging into system traces to spot failure modes and translate those insights into prompt, data, and workflow improvements.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Enterprise SaaS \& Functional Domain Expertise: Apply foundational knowledge of enterprise applications to validate AI responses and assist in troubleshooting functional processing errors.
* Hands\-On AI Evaluation: Review LLM outputs, conversation logs, and execution traces to identify edge cases, hallucinations, and routine failure modes. Perform structured data labeling and report findings to senior engineering staff.
* Technical Troubleshooting \& RCA: Assist in root\-cause analysis for software defects and pipeline execution failures using monitoring tools like Kibana and Grafana, following established diagnostic runbooks.
* Cloud \& LLM Diagnostics: Inspect enterprise AI workflows hosted in public cloud environments (AWS, GCP), helping isolate breakdown points across model hosting services and API gateways.
* Incident \& Queue Management: Monitor and triage support queues, enforce SLAs, and process incoming tickets efficiently. Support high\-severity incident responses and participate in weekend on\-call rotations.
* Customer Communication: Communicate clear technical updates, standard workarounds, and resolution steps to customer IT teams, working with senior support for high\-stakes escalations.
* Database \& Code Diagnostics: Write standard SQL queries to validate backend data integrity, inspect REST/SOAP API payloads (JSON/XML), and execute existing Python or Bash scripts to run routine diagnostics.
* Documentation \& Team Collaboration: Maintain detailed investigation logs in Jira, ServiceNow, or Salesforce, help maintain team runbooks, and flag recurring issue trends to senior engineers and product teams.


**About You**
**Basic Qualifications (Required)**
 Work Experience: Minimum 1 year of experience in technical support, platform operations, or application support for enterprise SaaS environments.
   

  

 Technical \& Diagnostic Skills:
   

  

* Minimum 1 year of experience writing and executing intermediate SQL queries and running diagnostic scripts.
* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting API payloads (JSON or XML data structures) and utilizing basic Linux or Windows command\-line tools.


 Cloud \& Monitoring Systems:
   

  

* Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience navigating or monitoring services on public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing observability tools (e.g., Grafana, Kibana, Datadog) to view logs or trace outputs.


 AI \& LLM Exposure:
   

  

* Minimum 1 year of experience inspecting, reading, or evaluating AI/LLM conversation logs, traces, or prompt outputs.


 Triage \& Operations:
   

  

* Minimum 1 year of experience performing initial queue triage and basic troubleshooting using ticketing workflows.


 Willingness and ability to work scheduled weekend and holiday coverage rotations.
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical work experience).
* Experience following established runbooks to perform guided, autonomous technical troubleshooting.
* History of drafting clear written technical documentation, post\-incident updates, or resolution notes for customer\-facing teams.
* Strong active problem\-solving skills and an adaptability to learn complex, multi\-tiered enterprise systems.

title: BI Analyst
description:
OneMagnify is an AI native, platform\-enabled B2B digital agency operating at the intersection of data, technology, and creativity. We help complex organizations drive measurable business outcomes by building smarter customer experiences and delivering highly integrated solutions across digital, media, and technology. By combining deep industry expertise with advanced analytics and artificial intelligence, we enable our clients to make better decisions, move faster, and compete more effectively in dynamic markets.
   

  

**The Impact You’ll Have:**
 We are hiring a BI Analyst to own the design, build and support of Power BI reporting for business teams across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Credit, Mobility, Connected Vehicle and Warranty. The majority of the work is hands\-on Power BI development on top of data in Google Cloud (BigQuery). You will work directly with business users to understand what they need, model the data properly, and deliver dashboards people actually use.
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports and datasets end to end — requirement gathering, data model, DAX measures, visuals, publishing and support.
* Write and tune SQL in BigQuery to prepare clean, reliable datasets for reporting.
* Design star\-schema data models and reusable, certified datasets so business teams can self\-serve instead of asking for one\-off reports.
* Set up refresh schedules, gateways, workspaces, row\-level security and deployment pipelines; keep report performance and query cost under control.
* Build transformation pipelines in Dataform (or dbt\-style SQL models) and schedule them; use Cloud Run / Cloud Functions for lightweight automation where needed.
* Investigate data issues, trace them back to the source, and put basic data quality checks in place.
* Sit with business stakeholders, translate their questions into metric definitions and specs, and document what you build.
* Replace manual and Excel\-based reporting with automated solutions.
* Support Gen AI / Vertex AI use cases where useful — natural\-language Q\&A on datasets, automated summaries, Copilot features in Power BI.
* Review work from junior analysts and help them level up.


**What you’ll need:**
* 3–7 years of hands\-on BI / reporting experience, with the bulk of it in Power BI (Power Query, DAX, data modelling, Power BI Service administration)/ similar tools.
* Strong SQL — joins, aggregations, window functions, and the ability to debug a slow query.
* Practical experience with a cloud data warehouse. GCP BigQuery preferred; Snowflake, Databricks, Azure Synapse / Fabric or Redshift equally considered.
* Working knowledge of ETL/ELT concepts and at least one transformation or workflow tool — Dataform, dbt, Alteryx, SAS, Dataflow or similar.
* Understanding of dimensional modelling and how to structure data for reporting rather than just extracting it.
* Ability to talk to non\-technical stakeholders, push back sensibly, and explain numbers clearly.
* A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, Statistics, Business Analytics or any quantitative field.


**Future\-Ready Skills (Nice to Have):**
* Python (pandas) for data prep or automation.
* Vertex AI, Gen AI / LLM\-assisted analytics, or Power BI Copilot exposure.
* Tableau, Qlik Sense or Looker experience alongside Power BI.
* Git / DevOps, CI\-CD for BI artefacts, Agile ways of working.
* Power Automate / Power Apps for workflow automation.
* Microsoft PL\-300 or Google Professional Data Engineer certification.
* Experience in integrated marketing, digital agency, marketing services, or consulting environments preferred.


**Benefits**
 We offer a comprehensive benefits package including Medical Insurance, PF, Gratuity, paid holidays, and more.
   

  

**We are an equal opportunity employer**
 We believe that Innovative ideas and solutions start with unique perspectives. That’s why we’re committed to providing every employee a workplace that’s free of discrimination and intolerance. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively search for like\-minded people to join our team.

description:

 We are looking for a Digital Analytics / Adobe Experience Cloud professional with 8\+ years of strong hands\-on experience across Adobe Analytics, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Adobe Web SDK, Adobe Target, and modern data collection architecture. The resource should be capable of independently handling implementation, troubleshooting, solution design, migration, and day\-to\-day technical discussions with clients — moving beyond execution/support to take end\-to\-end ownership of Digital Analytics engagements, from requirement gathering and solution design through implementation, debugging, validation, migration, and client communication.

 Translate business requirements into analytics measurement frameworks, event taxonomies, data layers, and implementation specifications.

 Ready to work from office

 Working knowledge of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) — XDM schemas, datasets, identities, data ingestion/flows — and hands\-on Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) experience (connections, data views, dimensions/metrics, calculated metrics, segmentation, cross\-channel reporting), including identity\-stitching concepts.

 Hands\-on experience with Adobe Target implementation and configuration (activities, audiences, offers, A/B and experience testing, personalization, recommendations), including Target \+ Adobe Analytics/AEP/CJA integration for measurement.

**Business Analyst – Role Profile**
**Role Purpose**
 The Senior Business Analyst works collaboratively across business and technology teams to analyse, design, and deliver process and system improvements. Operating within a hybrid transformation environment, the role plays a key part in defining requirements, optimising workflows, supporting intelligent automation initiatives, and ensuring high\-quality delivery through structured testing and stakeholder engagement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**About The Role**
 This role works on the technical core of JioHotstar's measurement stack \- attribution modeling, incrementality testing, and the data infrastructure that proves advertiser outcomes. You'll work closely with the GTM/partnerships team who takes your models and findings to market; you own the rigor, the build, and the numbers that hold up under leadership and advertiser scrutiny.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Deep\-dive analysis \& problem\-solving: Investigate measurement gaps and discrepancies, dig into raw data, and independently drive issues to resolution before they're flagged by others
* Model building: Build and maintain attribution, incrementality, and optimization models (e.g., ML\-based CPI/install optimization) using statistical and ML techniques such as linear and logistic regression
* Experimentation infrastructure: Design and run holdout/test\-control experiments, ensuring correct randomization and experimental integrity
* Engineering collaboration: Work with Engineering and Data Platform teams to productionize models, manage data pipelines, and enable privacy\-safe data collaboration
* Data quality \& governance: Establish and maintain data quality standards across measurement pipelines \- flag and resolve inconsistencies before they reach leadership or advertiser\-facing outputs, and ensure attribution/incrementality data remains accurate and audit\-ready
* Reporting infrastructure \& automation: Build and maintain reporting pipelines integrating internal systems, APIs, databases, and Google Sheets into BI platforms (e.g., Looker Studio); establish a single source of truth for business metrics
* Cross\-functional \& leadership engagement: Partner with Product and GTM/Strategy to translate technical findings into leadership \- and advertiser\-ready proof points; present directly to senior leadership and defend methodology under scrutiny


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* 4\-6 years in data science, analytics, or measurement/attribution roles, ideally within ad\-tech, martech, or a platform/marketplace environment
* Strong coding proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation, analysis, and modeling
* Solid grounding in statistical and ML techniques (linear regression, logistic regression, and related methods), with the judgment to choose the right method for the problem
* Experience building visualizations and automated executive dashboards in tools like Databricks, Looker, or Data Studio
* A demonstrated solution mindset with strong analytical rigor, comfortable being questioned on methodology and numbers
* Ability to present complex technical findings clearly and confidently to leadership and non\-technical stakeholders
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related discipline

title: Data Analyst - Lead
description:
Lead analyst would be working with global stakeholders on analysis of vertical performance \& other ad\-hoc analysis for strategic customers of FedEx.
   

  

 Expected to provide expert thought leadership at the enterprise level related to designs and implements advanced processes and analytics associated with a wide variety of data sets used for data/text mining, analysis, and prediction to enable informed business decisions. Gains insight into key business problems and deliverables by applying highly technical analysis techniques to examine structured and unstructured data from multiple disparate sources.
   

  

 Should possess and demonstrate understanding of core Business and Commercial concepts including financial metrics, market dynamics, and competitive landscapes.
   

  

 Communicates results to a broad range of audiences. Effectively uses current and emerging technologies to evaluate trends and develop actionable insights and recommendations to management, via understanding of the business model and the information available for analysis.
   

  

**Grade :T7**
**"Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date"**
 As a
 **Lead Measurement Analyst** 
 , you will be the strategic architect, operational manager, and subject matter expert (SME) driving our commercial performance measurement framework. Operating within the Commercial Analytics and Performance division, you will lead the end\-to\-end design, execution, delivery, and project management of sophisticated analytics that track FedEx global vertical performance.
   

  

 You will translate complex database queries and advanced statistical models into high\-level business justifications and executive\-level narratives. Serving as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, you will synthesize past, present, and future commercial trends to guide marketing, forecasting, and commercial business strategies. Additionally, you will champion analytical standards, distribute work tasks, manage delivery timelines, clear operational roadblocks, and mentor team members to foster a high\-performing culture of data\-driven decision\-making.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Vertical Performance**
* Own the end\-to\-end measurement framework for tracking global performance across priority industry verticals (e.g., E\-commerce, Healthcare, Aerospace, Technology).
* Lead deep\-dive analyses into critical revenue drivers, isolating trends in volume, pricing, and yield—specifically monitoring and developing strategies to address yield compression and regional performance variations.
* Design and champion the architecture of advanced Power BI dashboards and executive scorecards, establishing data modelling and reporting standards across the team.
* Collaborate with data engineering and business intelligence partners to optimize enterprise data structures, ensuring consistent data pipelines and high\-integrity reporting environments.


**Executive Consultation \& Narrative Delivery**
* Author and present high\-impact, narrative\-driven business reviews and strategic performance updates directly to executive leadership (e.g., CEO updates, senior staff briefings, and quarterly reviews).
* Translate complex statistical anomalies and commercial trends into clear, executive\-ready "so\-what" insights, detailing the past drivers, present status, and future outlook.
* Formulate data\-driven business cases and pricing/revenue simulations to support strategic adjustments in vertical targeting and market positioning.


**Advanced Statistics, AI, \& Cohort Modelling**
* Direct the implementation of advanced statistical methodologies (such as cohort analysis, regression, and pattern recognition) to identify and explain hidden trends in transactional datasets.
* Drive the business application of AI/Machine Learning models, leveraging clustering algorithms and predictive frameworks to refine customer cohorts, automate industry vertical tracking, and capture emerging micro\-trends.
* Partner with forecasting, marketing, and finance leaders to align historical performance models with forward\-looking growth forecasts and strategic demand plans.


**Team Leadership, Project Delivery, \& Governance**
* Task Distribution \& Backlog Management: Manage the intake of analytical requests, prioritize competing demands, and strategically distribute work packages across team members to align with individual strengths and project requirements.
* Timeline Tracking \& Progress Reporting: Track delivery milestones for major reporting cycles and ad\-hoc analytics projects, ensuring consistent execution and providing progress and bandwidth updates to department leadership.
* Roadblock Resolution: Act as a proactive buffer for the sub\-team, stepping in to resolve technical hurdles, cross\-functional data dependency bottlenecks, or query limitations by collaborating with IT, Data Engineering, and product groups.
* Process Optimization \& Automation: Continuously refine, standardize, and automate recurring analytics processes to reduce reporting cycle times and increase overall team responsiveness.
* Mentorship \& Quality Control: Establish and govern analytical standards, documentation, and query\-optimization practices, providing peer reviews and technical mentoring to mid\- and junior\-level analysts.


**What We’re Looking For**
**Experience \& Background**
* 7\+ years of progressive experience in business intelligence, commercial analytics, revenue management, or financial measurement.
* Proven experience in a "Lead", Project Lead, or senior consulting capacity, showcasing the ability to manage project pipelines, track timelines, and coordinate cross\-functional resources.
* Extensive experience querying large\-scale enterprise relational databases (e.g., Snowflake, Teradata, BigQuery) and building advanced visualization frameworks.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating the successful translation of complex analytical findings into executive level presentations and business cases.


**Core Competencies**
* Operational \& Delivery Leadership: Excellent capacity to organize project plans, delegate tasks, track delivery timelines, and maintain team output while actively mitigating risks and clearing technical roadblocks.
* Strategic Influence \& Executive Storytelling: Exceptional ability to synthesize complex, multi\-layered data into clear, persuasive, and action\-oriented narratives for senior executives.
* Analytical Leadership \& Rigor: High\-level problem\-solving capability; a track record of formulating robust business hypotheses and establishing rigorous standards for data integrity and statistical validity.
* Consultative Stakeholder Management: Ability to collaborate seamlessly with senior directors and cross\-functional teams (Sales, Finance, Pricing, and Marketing) across global time zones.
* Innovation \& Change Champion: Proactive approach to adopting new technologies (such as GenAI, machine learning, and automation tools) to optimize legacy reporting systems.


**Professional Expertise \& Technical Skills**
* Analytics \& Data Modelling: Expert proficiency in SQL (required) paired with strong data architecture and modelling skills.
* Advanced Applied Statistics: Mastery of statistical concepts (e.g., sampling, significance, correlation, predictive modelling) applied directly to commercial cohorts and behavioural segmentations.
* Business AI \& Machine Learning: Practical experience leveraging machine learning concepts (e.g., clustering algorithms, decision trees, NLP/text analytics) to drive customer segmentation, automate tracking, and isolate performance anomalies.
* Data Visualization: Advanced development skills in Power BI or similar enterprise\-grade visualization suites.
* Programming \& Automation: Strong proficiency in Python or R to build reproducible data models, script automation pipelines, and execute advanced analytics.
* Productivity \& Presentation: Expert command of MS Excel (advanced modelling) and PowerPoint (drafting highly polished, visually compelling slides for leadership reviews).


**Certifications
 *(nice to have)***
* Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified Analytics Professional (CAP), Agile/Scrum certification, Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt), or equivalent.


 FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
   

  

 Our Company
   

  

 FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Data Analyst - Senior
description:
As a Senior Data Analyst, measurement, you will be the analytical engine behind our commercial performance tracking. Serving within the Global Verticals Marketing team, you will act as the primary point of contact for querying, analysing, and synthesizing FedEx internal transactional and customer data. Your mission is to convert complex datasets into clear, actionable vertical performance narratives that guide business planning.
   

  

 In this role, you will build executive\-ready reports, conduct ad\-hoc analyses, and provide data\-driven insights that directly support marketing, commercial strategy, and forecasting functions. Your work will directly influence how senior leadership understands vertical health, product performance, and regional business dynamics.
   

  

**Grade : T5**
**"Please note that the Job will close at 12am on Posting Close date, so please submit your application prior to the Close Date"**
 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Vertical Performance
   

  

* Write, optimize, and execute complex SQL queries against FedEx enterprise data warehouses to extract performance metrics across priority industry verticals (e.g., E\-commerce, Healthcare, Aerospace, Technology).
* Monitor and analyse key commercial indicators, including volume, revenue, and yield, with a specific focus on identifying regional / lane / product level insights.
* Investigate regional and product\-level performance variations, isolating root causes of growth or decline and translating findings into structured data briefs.
* Build, maintain, and automate interactive performance dashboards and scorecards to track commercial performance, vertical health, and pipeline health.


 Executive \& Leadership Reporting
   

  

* Synthesize complex performance datasets into high\-impact, visual, and narrative\-driven reports for leadership and executive\-level business updates (e.g., CEO updates and strategic reviews).
* Translate analytical findings into concise executive takeaways, ensuring executive communications clearly explain the past performance, present status, and future outlook.
* Deliver regular monthly and quarterly performance updates, highlighting competitive risks, commercial opportunities, and customer journey trends.


 Strategic \& Forecasting Support
   

  

* Partner with forecasting, strategy, finance, and marketing functions to model commercial funnels, market demand shifts, and historical volume trends.
* Apply statistical techniques and behavioural segmentation models to track, isolate, and forecast changes in specific customer cohorts and industry verticals.
* Conduct rapid\-response, ad\-hoc deep dives to answer critical, time\-sensitive business questions posed by leadership.
* Provide data backing and baseline historical trends to support annual commercial strategic planning and commercial goal setting.


 What We’re Looking For
   

  

 Experience \& Background
   

  

* 6\-10 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, sales analytics, or financial/commercial measurement roles.
* Proven experience querying large\-scale, complex relational databases to extract commercial, transactional, and customer\-level insights.
* Demonstrated track record of preparing executive\-calibre presentations, briefs, and reports based on complex data analysis.
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional, global stakeholders across various time zones.


 Core Competencies
   

  

* Executive Storytelling \& Visualization: The ability to translate numbers into a cohesive, executive\-ready story that leaders can grasp and act on instantly.
* Statistical Thinking \& Pattern Discovery: Strong capability to utilize business statistics (e.g., correlation, significance testing, regression, trend analysis) to


 robustly identify patterns, validate data anomalies, and extract high\-integrity insights from raw corporate data.
   

  

* Analytical Rigor \& Structured Problem Solving: High attention to data accuracy, methodological soundness, and the ability to formulate logical business hypotheses.
* Agility \& Proactiveness: Comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment, managing competing priorities, and delivering quick\-turnaround ad\-hoc analyses.


**Professional Expertise \& Technical Skills**
* Analytics \& BI: High proficiency in SQL (required) and experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Teradata, or BigQuery).
* Applied Business Statistics: Practical knowledge of statistical methods to perform cohort analysis, customer segmentation, and behavioural pattern recognition to discover performance anomalies.
* Business AI \& Machine Learning Application: Understanding of how to leverage predictive models, clustering algorithms (e.g., for cohort refinement), and NLP/text mining to automate industry vertical tracking, spot micro\-trends, and optimize customer group definitions.
* Data Visualization: Proficiency in building dashboards in Power BI or similar BI tools
* Programming \& Automation: Comfortable using Python or R for statistical modelling, data manipulation, and analytical process automation is a must.
* Productivity \& Reporting: Expert\-level skills in MS Excel (advanced formulas, pivot tables) and PowerPoint (to draft polished, executive\-ready presentations).


 Sector Familiarity: Prior experience analysing commercial performance within B2B verticals (e.g., Retail/E\-commerce, Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Industrial, Technology) is highly valued.
   

  

* Exposure to CRM/sales enablement tools (e.g., Salesforce)


 Certifications (nice to have)
   

  

* CFA, FRM, PMP, Six Sigma (or equivalent).

title: Manager / Sr. Manager - Deal Analytics
description:
**Description**
**Company Profile:**
 Alvarez \& Marsal is a leading global professional services firm specializing in providing turnaround management, performance improvement and corporate advisory services. With over 10000 professionals based across North America, Europe, Asia, and Latin America, our firm excels in problem solving and value creation. Drawing on a strong operational heritage and hands\-on\-approach, our professionals work closely with organizations and stakeholders to help tackle complex business issues and maximize value.
   

  

 From its India office, A\&M offers turnaround and restructuring advisory, interim and crisis management, performance improvement, transaction advisory and disputes and investigation services to PE firms, local and multinational firms and banks. Additionally, A\&M brings industry expertise to India in a range of sectors, including automotive, business process outsourcing (BPO), consumer products, industrial products, private equity, transportation \& infrastructure, manufacturing, retail, technology, telecommunications and textiles.
   

  

**Team Profile**
 Alvarez \& Marsal’s Disputes and Investigations (DI) works with clients to advise on transaction advisory across Investment lifecycle, risk management, leakage prevention, anti\-bribery and corruption consulting, fraud investigations, anti\-fraud programs and controls, regulatory compliance, litigation support and bankruptcy matters. DI team provides expertise to manage and minimize securities litigation and regulatory compliance risks.
   

  

 Data Analytics team within DI brings technological innovation to support technology led programs using cutting edge tools and techniques.
   

  

**Position Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Manager / Senior Manager to join our Deal Analytics team within the Disputes and Investigations practice. In this role, you will lead end\-to\-end delivery of pre\-investment due diligence engagements, leveraging advanced analytics and AI\-driven techniques.
   

  

 The role requires strong commercial acumen, deep analytical expertise, and a proven track record of leading data\-driven due diligence across sectors including Consumer, Financial Services, FinTech, Retail, and Healthcare. You will work with large and complex datasets to generate actionable insights, design scalable analytical frameworks, and develop reusable tools and assets.
   

  

 You will be responsible for ensuring high\-quality deliverables, driving technical excellence, and developing tailored, data\-driven solutions aligned to client needs. Additionally, you will lead and mentor teams, manage client relationships, and actively contribute to practice development and capability building.
   

  

**Job Roles \& Responsibilities**
**Engagement Leadership \& Deal Execution:**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of data\-driven pre\-investment due diligence engagements, from hypothesis framing and data acquisition to insight generation and reporting.
* Act as a trusted advisor to private equity clients and deal teams, providing actionable insights on revenue quality, margin sustainability, customer dynamics, and operational risks.
* Manage engagement scope, timelines, and budgets, ensuring high\-quality and timely delivery in fast\-paced transaction environments.
* Translate analytical outputs into investment\-relevant insights and clear deal narratives to support decision\-making.


**Deal Analytics \& Technical Delivery**
* Design and execute advanced analytics frameworks to assess key diligence areas such as revenue leakage, pricing anomalies, customer concentration, channel risks, and working capital dynamics.
* Work with large, complex, and multi\-source datasets (ERP, CRM, transactional systems) to derive meaningful insights under tight timelines.
* Strong expertise in SQL, Python, and Power BI for data extraction, analysis, and visualization.
* Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint for analytics and executive storytelling.
* Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and analytical techniques.
* Oversee data extraction, transformation, and analysis using SQL and Python, ensuring robustness, scalability, and auditability of outputs.
* Develop interactive dashboards and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI) tailored for investor and management discussions.
* Apply AI/ML and GenAI techniques to enhance diligence processes, including anomaly detection, pattern recognition, and automated insight generation.
* Build and scale reusable analytics assets, accelerators, and diligence playbooks to improve consistency and efficiency across deals.


**Team Leadership \& Quality Assurance**
* Lead and mentor cross\-functional teams of analysts and consultants, providing direction on problem structuring, analytics approach, and storytelling.
* Drive quality control through structured review mechanisms, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and relevance of outputs.
* Foster a high\-performance, collaborative environment with a focus on innovation and continuous learning.


**Practice Development \& Commercial Support**
* Contribute to the development of deal analytics capabilities, offerings, and go\-to\-market strategies.
* Support proposals, client pitches, and solution design, bringing differentiated analytics\-led perspectives to transactions.
* Identify opportunities to expand scope within engagements and drive additional value for clients.
* Build reusable IP, tools, and sector\-specific analytics solutions to strengthen the practice.


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build strong relationships with private equity clients, deal teams, and portfolio company management.
* Collaborate with commercial, financial, and operational diligence teams to deliver integrated insights.
* Communicate complex analytical findings in a clear, concise, and commercially relevant manner to senior stakeholders.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* 6–10\+ years of experience in data analytics, deal analytics, transaction advisory, or consulting roles.
* Proven experience in pre\-investment due diligence or transaction\-related analytics engagements.
* Strong expertise in SQL, Python, and Power BI for data extraction, analysis, and visualization.
* Experience in consulting environments (Big4 or similar) preferred.


**Your Journey At A\&M**
* We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.
* We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.

title: Enterprise Data Advisor
description:
At Franklin Templeton, we believe success is built through powerful partnerships. As a forward‑thinking asset manager, we build dynamic relationships with clients, understand their goals, and navigate complex markets together. We leverage cutting‑edge strategies and deep insights to unlock opportunities for long‑term wealth creation. Our talented, global teams bring expertise that is both broad and unique.
   

  

 From our welcoming, inclusive, and supportive culture to our globally diverse business, we offer opportunities not only to help you reach your potential, but also to contribute to our clients’ success.
   

  

 Franklin Templeton is seeking an Enterprise Data Advisor (EDA) to serve as the primary bridge between the lines of business and the Enterprise Data Office, establishing a shared understanding of data across the organization, educating teams on available data assets, and ensuring Franklin Templeton data is governed, trusted, and usable at scale. The role connects business users, data owners, technology platforms, and governance standards to enable effective data adoption and regulatory grade data quality. The EDA works across programs and initiatives to guide teams away from legacy and manual data practices toward secure, well defined, and authoritative enterprise datasets while aligning data quality controls to business criticality and collaborating with Data Stewards, Data Owners, Data Producers, and Data Consumers.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Responsible for establishing standards, guidelines, and processes used to maintain common, firm wide data standards to protect FTI’s critical information assets.
* Develops, maintains, and implements strategies that increase the consistency/confidence of data used for decision making, improving knowledge firm wide.
* Facilitate delivery of data driven solutions for assigned LOB (Line of Business).
* Participate in data and analytics projects for assigned LOB.
* Support transition from legacy point solutions to governed enterprise data consumption.
* Conduct root cause analysis and recommend solutions.
* Develop and maintain relationships across assigned LOB.
* Provide expert guidance and implementation advice for using data effectively within and across business operational processes.
* Act as a single point of governance alignment.
* Proactively assess LOB governance maturity and work with LOB data management team to implement practical enterprise data management standards and best practices (ex. data quality, metadata management, etc.).
* Partner with Data Owners and Stewards to ensure dataset ownership and usage clarity.
* Develop and facilitate the adoption, education, and training of data assets, analytics tools, and techniques (Data Literacy).
* Collaborate with technology teams and Business Relationship Managers.
* Work with Enterprise Data Office (EDO) specialists to deliver business value.


**Qualifications**
* 5–8 years related experience in data management, data governance, analytics, or related discipline.
* Experience supporting data and analytics initiatives within a Line of Business (LOB) preferred.
* Understanding of Data Governance frameworks and tools, including:
+ Data ownership and stewardship roles
+ Data quality management principles and capabilities
+ Data cataloging and metadata capabilities
+ Data lifecycle and lineage concepts
+ Enterprise data standards and policies

* Working knowledge of modern data ecosystems, such as data warehousing, cloud platforms and business intelligence tools.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders without direct authority and drive alignment across competing priorities.
* Strong relationship management skills.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and documentation skills.
* Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience in Data, Technology, Business, or related fields required.

title: BI Lab Manager
description:
**Job Description**
 Ecolab seeks a business\-centric analytics professional who excels at turning ambiguous questions into actionable insights and has deep expertise in evolving those insights into scalable, production\-ready solutions.
   

  

 This role is the leader of a small team that sits at the intersection of business strategy, data, and product thinking. The primary strength of this role is the ability to quickly understand business context, translate it into meaningful metrics and analyses, and deliver relevant outputs that move decision\-making forward.
   

  

 In addition to leading the team, this individual will work iteratively with a variety of stakeholders across the enterprise. The day\-to\-day may include rapidly prototyping analyses, tools, or visualizations, refining them with stakeholders, and ultimately identifying which solutions should be scaled. As solutions mature, they will partner with BI developers and data engineers to operationalize them.
   

  

 The person in this role will either facilitate the start of scaled solutions or they may contribute to hands\-on delivery of scaled solution.
   

  

 Success in this role is defined not by technical complexity, but by the ability to deliver relevant, impactful, data solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into data\-driven solutions
+ Engage stakeholders to understand goals, context, and constraints
+ Identify the most relevant questions, metrics, and drivers of value

* Rapidly prototype insights and analytical tools
+ Move quickly from problem definition to gathering data to delivering an insight.
+ Deliver early versions of analyses, dashboards, models, or lightweight tools either via PowerPoint, PowerBI, Streamlit, or custom AI tools.
+ Iterate based on feedback to refine usefulness and clarity


* Apply the appropriate analytical approach
+ Determine when to use visualization, statistical analysis, modeling, or simple heuristics to a business problem.
+ Balance speed, rigor, and usability based on the situation (including the maturity of the question and the needs of the business).

* Perform data transformation and analysis
+ Use SQL or Python to source, clean, and transform data into useable data for analysis. If engaged in scaling data transformation, leverage dbt to create a scaled and tested data model for consumption.

* Design meaningful metrics and outputs
+ Define metrics that align with real business outcomes. Work with stakeholders to understand gaps in metric definitions or propose functional alternatives.
+ Ensure outputs are interpretable, actionable, and relevant to business needs.

* Evolve prototypes into scalable solutions
+ Translate prototypes into clear requirements for BI developers and data engineers
+ Partner cross\-functionally to scale solutions into production
+ Sometimes contribute to scaled products.

* Operate flexibly between guidance and execution
+ Provide direction and oversight when resources allow
+ Contribute hands\-on development when needed in resource\-constrained environments

* Drive insight\-led decision\-making
+ Use outputs to guide and advance stakeholder conversations
+ Continuously refine questions and approaches through iteration

* Team Leadership
+ Coach direct reports and “dotted line” analysts on ways to improve solution development.


**Required Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data science
* 3\-5 Years of Direct People Management Experience
* Strong proficiency in SQL for data extraction and transformation
* Proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, or prototyping
* Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar)
* Demonstrated ability to translate business problems into analytical approaches and solutions
* Experience working directly with stakeholders and iterating on analytical outputs
* Strong problem\-framing and prioritization skills, with a focus on business impact


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with dbt for data transformation and modeling
* Experience building lightweight applications or prototypes using tools such as Streamlit.
* Familiarity with semantic models in Snowflake
* Experience with AI\-enabled analytics tools such as Snowflake Cortex Agent or Databricks Genie.
* Experience implementing or supporting data quality testing frameworks.
* Exposure to product\-oriented thinking in analytics (e.g., scaling dashboards, tools, or data products)
* Ability to translate exploratory work into structured requirements for engineering teams
* Experience with GitHub or other CI/CD pipeline tools.
* Experience using Claude Code or similar GenAI development tools.


**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose\-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
   

  

**Overview** 
  

  

 MUFG is seeking an IT Business Analyst with 4\+ years of experience to support dynamic initiatives within its Private Equity business. This is a role focused on analysing financial processes, defining technology requirements, and partnering with agile teams to deliver impactful solutions. The position involves cross\-functional collaboration across business and technology groups. Depending on project needs, responsibilities may span both business analysis and delivery management, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to end\-to\-end solution delivery. The candidate should be a seasoned IT Business Analyst with expertise in system architecture, development, release management, support and agile/scrum delivery
   

**Key Accountabilities and main responsibilities** 
  

 Strategic Focus 
   

* Lead analysis for system modernization, cloud transitions, and API\-driven architectures.
* Support adoption of low\-code/no\-code platforms, automation, and real\-time processing systems.
* Shape future\-ready digital ecosystems
* Drive projects for enterprise data lakes, analytics platforms, and AI enablement.
* Translate business needs into data models, reporting logic, and analytics requirements.
* Identifying processes ripe for BPM, RPA, workflow automation, and AI\-driven decisioning.
* Redesigning processes for efficiency, transparency, and cost reduction.


  

 Operational Management 
   

* Translate financial and accounting requirements into actionable Business Requirements Documents and Agile User Stories in Azure DevOps.
* Work closely with developers to clarify requirements and ensure business needs are met.
* Troubleshoot issues and write requirements that will instruct development on the business resolution needed.
* Serve as Quality Assurance by developing and executing test cases to verify work during the system integration testing phase.
* Deliver demos of completed enhancements to end users.
* Help remove obstacles that hinder team progress.
* Monitor team performance, generate Velocity Burn Down Reports, and lead corrective actions.
* Conduct user interviews to identify process improvement opportunities and document current (“As\-Is”) and future (“To\-Be”) workflows.
* Create and maintain documentation including meeting notes, knowledge articles, and business communications.
* Serve as the Agile Team’s Scrum Master for assigned initiatives.
* Ensure adherence to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Change Management processes; conduct internal audits for compliance.


  

 People Leadership 
   

* Collaborate and work closely with business partners, Business Analysts, Project Managers, and other stakeholders.
* Coordinate delivery of client requests and production fixes (also strategic).
* Support knowledge sharing and documentation to uplift team capability


  

 Governance \& Risk 
   

* Familiarity with secure coding practices and encryption techniques for sensitive financial data.
* Ensure IT solutions embed compliance\-by\-design.
* Work closely with Legal/Risk teams to translate regulatory mandates into system requirements.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate operational and technology risks across data pipelines, cloud services, and platform components by establishing proactive monitoring, incident response protocols, and regular risk reviews.
* Strengthen governance frameworks by embedding quality standards, audit readiness, policy enforcement, and documentation practices to reduce operational vulnerabilities and ensure consistent, compliant data operations.


  

 The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time\-to\-time based on business needs.
   

**Experience \& Personal Attributes** 
  

 Experience 
   

* Candidate should possess at least 4\+ years of relevant experience as an IT Business Analyst and an Engineering degree / BS degree.
* Strong background in requirements gathering, testing, issue tracking, and leading technical deliveries.
* Strong understanding of accounting/finance systems and translating business needs into software requirements
* Proven ability to work independently and troubleshoot technical issues
* Technical troubleshooting and problem solving
* Experience in Finance Industry, with Private Equity experience preferred
* Proficient in advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Word and Visio.  Proficiency in Power BI or Power Automate preferred


  

 Personal Attributes
   

* Ability to work independently or as part of a team
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills required, and the ability to complete projects with little or no supervision.
* Strong oral and written communication skills
* Ability to guide and mentor junior team members on solution architecture and other technical topics.
* Ability to work as part of a cross\-cultural team
* Must be able to operate in a stressful, quality and deadline driven environment while maintaining strict attention to detail and the ability to prioritize issues appropriately while managing multiple assignments.
* Ability to take initiative and critically analyse processes and procedures.
* Continuous improvement focus, with the ability to identify risks, cost efficiencies, and operational improvements
* Strong presentation and communication skills with ability to communicate clearly and effectively at all levels
* Ability to effectively liaise with senior\-level stakeholders to communicate issues, risks, and solutions
* Self\-driven and motivated with a focus on operational efficiency and continuous improvement

description:

 Senior Analyst – GBS Commercial

*We are seeking a detail\-oriented* 
*Business Analyst*
